name: fleet
description: Per project: background sessions ask you without stopping, and you answer from any session of the project with /fleet, at no token cost; a write of a shared file that changed since the session read it is refused once with who changed it, and the session hears of such changes at its next step; records cited by version (R-12@4) make their citers suspect when revised, a write citing a stale version is refused once, and the project's check scripts run as its linters
